feature: Automatic Page Access route inventory generation

flows.name: Frontend-root build generation
steps: Prepare the production build from the frontend root
Compile Next.js with the regenerated static import
flows.expectedOutcome: The deployed Page Access inventory reflects the routes in that deployment without a manually refreshed committed snapshot.

claims.description: The Vercel frontend-root build derives inventory rows from deployed source before compilation.
Missing source or empty inventory stops the build with a recovery action.
Local audit reporting and frontend-root build generation share one route derivation.
